Involvemewnt

If the party refuse to hand over  Shadowheart Gydd fights alongside Mother Superior  Viconia DeVir. Like the other Sharran Fidelians, he is primarily a spellcaster, and douses the battlefield in darkness to debuff his opponents.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Beckoning Darkness ()
Damage: 2~16
2d8⁠Necrotic
Curse a creature to be haunted by darkness. It takes 2d8Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.
 CHA Save
 Range: 4 m (13 ft)
 Bone Chill ()
Damage: 1~8
1d8⁠Necrotic
Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help  Downed characters. An undead target receives  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls.
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Darkness ( + )

Create a cloud of magical darkness that  Heavily Obscures and inflicts  Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Shadow Step ()

Teleport from shadow to shadow.

Afterwards, you have  Advantage on your next melee  Attack Roll.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
